messages:
Maya: Quick check  anyone up for a 15-min 'desk-decor rescue' pop-up tomorrow at 4? bring a stray ornament to fix, or just come to cheer. low-key, holiday chaos welcome. :evergreen_tree:
Owen: I'm in! My desk elf lost an eye last week I need repair help. Also bringing superglue. :mechanical_arm:
Priya: Count me in for moral support and adhesive counsel. Also offering a 3-track playlist: 'tiny bells', 'soft synth carols', 'suspiciously peppy elevator remixes'.
Felix: I will offer a 30-second holiday dad joke and a meme submission. Prize: leftover sticker from last hackathon.
Maya: calendar-bot: can you make this a public 15-min slot and add a reminder 10 minutes before?
calendar-bot: Event created: "Desk-Decor Rescue & Tiny Holiday Cheer"  Tomorrow 4:00 PM  15 min  Attendees: Maya, Owen, Priya, Felix
Owen: quick poll for snacks: chocolate, fruit, both. Reply with the word you want.
Priya: chocolate
Maya: both
Felix: fruit (trying to be healthy, lol)
Owen: noted. thanks! See you tomorrow :sparkles:
Priya: also, big kudos to Ops for sorting printers this week. felt like holiday magic. :tada:
Felix: seconded. ops team deserves candy canes. :candy:
